title: Copy-Paste Comment Errors
pattern: Identical comments or doc-comments on adjacent, distinct methods or fields due to unchecked copying.
why_bad: Lies and confusion. Copy-paste errors lead to severe documentation bugs, indicating that the developer did not write or review the code with care and rendering all surrounding documentation untrustworthy.
detection: Two or more consecutive functions, structures, or fields having identical doc-comments.
counterexample: Adjacent setters each documented with their own accurate one-liner ('Set the start timeout.' / 'Set the stop timeout.').
fix: Update the duplicated comment to accurately describe the unique behavior of the target item.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("Scary Noise").
